title: CY50111: Heterocycles In Medicines
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NilOverview of chemistry aromatic Heterocycles and fused
Heterocycles, porphyrins and flavones. Heterocycles in the pharmaceutical
industry: Antibacterial agents viz. Penicillins, Cephalosporins, novel betalactam antibiotics, Antifungal drugs viz. Pyridotriazine,Calcium Channel
blockers viz Nifedipine and Amlodipine, Potasium channel opening vasodilator
viz. pinacidil, Antiinflammatory agents viz. Piroxicam, selective inhibitor of
type 5PDE viz. SildenafilBooks: J.A. Joule and K.Mills, Heterocyclic Chemistry;
Graham L. Patrick, An Introduction to Medicinal Chemistry.
